beats.text: Think Halloween weather can't get wild around LaPorte? The records say otherwise.
beats.label: HALLOWEEN, ON THE RECORD

beats.text: In 2013, a storm soaked Halloween night. One LaPorte gauge caught 2.98 inches of rain, and Fort Wayne had its wettest Halloween on record.
beats.label: HALLOWEEN 2013

beats.text: In 2014, a gust hit 67 miles an hour over the lake off Michigan City, and out in the middle of Lake Michigan, waves topped 21 feet.
beats.label: HALLOWEEN 2014

beats.text: In 2019, Halloween brought snow: 2.2 inches near Valparaiso, and Chicago's snowiest Halloween on record.
beats.label: HALLOWEEN 2019

beats.text: In 2023, South Bend got 1.4 inches of snow on Halloween, its second-snowiest ever, just behind a record 1.6 inches in the 1950s.
beats.label: HALLOWEEN 2023

beats.text: And the coldest? In 1917, South Bend's high on Halloween was just 35 degrees.
beats.label: THE COLDEST

beats.text: What's the wildest Halloween you remember? Tell us in the comments. Saturday's trick-or-treat forecast is at laporteweathernow.com.

factcheck.result: Lines 1, 2, 4, 6, 7 supported. Line 3: the 21-ft waves were at the mid-lake buoy, so 'in the middle of Lake Michigan' and the rain taken off the lighthouse scene. Line 5: WSBT dates the 1.6-in. record 1956, ABC57 1954, so the video says 'the 1950s'.
